hypothesis: Incremental SSE responses may avoid non-stream gateway timeouts; this is unproven before the probe.
transport_acceptance: Only complete streams with a stable provider response ID, finish marker, terminal DONE and verified final prompt/completion usage can supply an action. HTTP redirects/errors, disconnects, malformed data, missing usage and deadline failures remain failures.
measurement_rule: Report transport request outcomes separately from model-format and code-correctness outcomes. Two samples of one prompt cannot confirm semantic training signal or causal reliability benefit.
boundaries: Same credential, host and pinned provider; no alternate credentials or upload attempts.
No task/oracle/reward/parser forgiveness or execution-limit change.
No training, ranking improvement, promotion or Arena submission.
